statement: This file declares authority assumptions that external Codex/runtime policy must satisfy. It does not grant permissions, approvals, credentials, network access, tool access, or deployment authority.

project_trust.reason: Project-scoped Codex configuration must only participate for a trusted project.

approval_policy.reason: Boundary-crossing operations must not run under an approval posture that suppresses review.

permission_profile.reason: Unrestricted filesystem/network execution is outside the repository safety envelope.

unrestricted_mode.reason: Approval/sandbox bypass modes are forbidden for governed repository work.

production_kalshi_credentials_present.reason: Codex must never receive production Kalshi credentials.

codex_has_kalshi_execution_credentials.reason: The Codex/agent process must not receive Kalshi execution credentials or authentication material.

production_kalshi_network_enabled.reason: Production Kalshi network reachability must remain unavailable to Codex-governed execution.

managed_policy_revision.reason: Managed deployments should identify the externally enforced policy revision.

capability_snapshot_id.reason: A runtime capability snapshot improves reproducibility but may be unavailable in local-only deployments.

environment_id.reason: Environment identity improves reproducibility but does not itself grant authority.
